Haryana Congress Leaders Show Public Disagreement Amidst Party In-charge Visit

During a visit by the Haryana Congress in-charge, prominent state leaders Bhupinder Singh Hooda and Randeep Surjewala displayed public tension. Both leaders made remarks that appeared to be directed at each other, highlighting ongoing factionalism within the state unit of the party. The event occurred in Chandigarh and was observed by other party leaders.
